blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines —Albert Ian Delos Santos showed the future is bright after delivering a bronze medal in his Asian Games weightlifting debut while setting a new junior world record on Saturday. Delos Santos shattered his junior world record twice in his final two clean and jerk attempts, lifting 181 and 183 kilograms, for a total of 324 kg in the men’s 70-kg final at Nagoya City Trade and Industry Center. His final clean and jerk and total also set new junior Asian records. The 20-year-old Filipino was the youngest […]...
